price_setup.title: Set up your price profile
price_setup.description: Prices use {currency}/kWh. For euros, enter 0.05 for 5 cents/kWh. If you set a window across midnight, use an end time earlier than the start.

data.fallback: If the price limit prevents enough running time

price_preview_empty.title: Review your profile
price_preview_empty.description:
No run was selected for the current prices and settings. Check your settings or save and see the profile's current status.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_unavailable.title: Review your profile
price_preview_unavailable.description:
The preview is unavailable. Check whether the selected price source has current prices.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_threshold_active.title: Review your profile
price_preview_threshold_active.description:
Price now: {current_price} {currency}/kWh. Your limit: {threshold} {currency}/kWh. **Use electricity now** would be on.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_threshold_scheduled.title: Review your profile
price_preview_threshold_scheduled.description:
The signal is off now. The next price at or below your limit of {threshold} {currency}/kWh starts at {next_start} (Home Assistant local time).

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_threshold_above.title: Review your profile
price_preview_threshold_above.description:
Price now: {current_price} {currency}/kWh. That exceeds your limit of {threshold} {currency}/kWh. The signal would be off.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_schedule_active.title: Review your profile
price_preview_schedule_active.description:
The first run is due now: {start} – {end}. Planned running time: {planned_duration} minutes.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_schedule_scheduled.title: Review your profile
price_preview_schedule_scheduled.description:
First run: {start} – {end}, in Home Assistant local time. The schedule has {planned_duration} of the requested {required_duration} minutes.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_waiting.title: Review your profile
price_preview_waiting.description:
Waiting for the prices needed for this profile. After saving, the profile updates when the source provides those prices.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_price_ceiling.title: Review your profile
price_preview_price_ceiling.description:
The price ceiling prevents a complete schedule. You can keep the limit or change it.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_deadline.title: Review your profile
price_preview_deadline.description:
The required running time does not fit before the deadline. Try an earlier start, later finish, or shorter run.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_insufficient_duration.title: Review your profile
price_preview_insufficient_duration.description:
There is not enough eligible time for the requested run. Check the running time and window.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_constraints_unsatisfied.title: Review your profile
price_preview_constraints_unsatisfied.description:
The current prices cannot satisfy all of your settings at once. Check the price ceiling, running time, and deadline.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).

price_preview_no_eligible.title: Review your profile
price_preview_no_eligible.description:
No priced intervals match the selected window. Check the start and finish times.

After saving, open the profile to check its signal and schedule. See [how to use the signal in an automation]({automation_guide_url}).
